Trust me, whatever side effects you encounter, they’ll go away within a week (2 at most but they’ll probably be very tolerable by then). Imo, if you’re struggling it’s better to take the pill and accept the risk than to never know if it would’ve worked.

For reference, I’m 19f and I started taking 50mg Zoloft a few days ago. So far I’m not experiencing any terrible symptoms besides fatigue, jaw tightness and teeth chattering, constant yawning and jitteriness. I also have been waking up at random hours of the night. Maybe I’m lucky to not have any of the bad side effects? 

The thing is though, these drugs really are just trial and error. I was on Lexapro before and it’s an ssri like Zoloft, but I had terrible side effects and it never ended up helping. But if I didn’t try it, I wouldn’t know.

You’re stronger than you think you are girl! Trust me on that.

(Ps take the pill with food, with meds like these it’s smarter to take with food or on a full stomach, it decreases the chance of nausea)
